title: Designing an Evaluation Framework for LLMs in Astronomy
abstract: This paper presents a chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to evaluate LLMs in astronomy.

title: AstroLLaMA: Towards Specialized Foundation Models in Astronomy
abstract: AstroLLaMA is a fine-tuned large language model that performs well on astronomy tasks.

title: Galactic ChitChat: Conversational Systems for Astronomy Literature
abstract: This study explores how LLMs can summarize and compare astronomy research papers.

title: RAG-Check: Evaluating Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation
abstract: Proposes a testing framework for RAG models applied to scientific literature.
